_source: Recorded from a live Sub2API deployment on 2026-08-14 via GET /v1/usage with an API key. Balances and token counts are the real recorded values; no identifiers were present in the response to scrub.
_note: daily_usage came back empty under every window parameter tried (days, start/end, start_date/end_date, detail). With an API key this deployment exposes cumulative totals and a today bucket and nothing else, which is why the adapter reports summary level.

fingerprints._note: Unauthenticated probe results measured on two live sites. 404 means the route does not exist in that program; 401 means it does and wants a credential.
